constants.name: MIN_SOL_IN_THRESHOLD
docs: 0.001 SOL represented in lamports
if `sol_in` < `MIN_SOL_IN_THRESHOLD` contract does not update `curve.last_buyer` to prevent dust griffing
Minimum SOL amount required for a buy to become the new Last Buy.
Smaller buys are valid trades but do not affect the Last Buy timer
or winner eligibility.
